title: Kylo Ren Enraged
description: Kylo Ren was furious. He has learned the map to Luke Skywalker has slipped through his fingers, and retreats to his quarters to think. One of Kylo's officers, Lieutenant Mitaka, enters to brief him on BB-8's disappearance. Ren does not, and can not, restrain his temper, Force choking the lieutenant.
